_method: Held-out test set, same unit and labelling as ground_truth.json (unit = app x category). 'documented' was written from each app's official vulnerability list on 1 October 2026, before any of these apps was scanned. Rules were not changed after seeing these results. 'reviewed' only labels categories the scanner reported that the docs do not mention, after checking the report evidence.
_notes: Held-out scores: none of these apps was used to write or tune the rules, and the rules were not changed after this run.
Documented issues that live only in native or Flutter code are listed as out of scope: the scanner reads the manifest, resources and decompiled Java/Kotlin.

Insecure Data Storage: 3-6. Insecure Data Storage parts 1-4 (SharedPreferences, SQLite, temp file, external storage)
Insecure WebView: 8. Input Validation Issues part 2 (WebView loads any URL, including file://)
Exported Components: 9-11. Access Control Issues parts 1-3 (exported activities, content provider without permission)

out_of_scope: 13. Input Validation Issues part 3 (native buffer overflow)
